responsibility: This header defines checking-build fixtures for selftests of GCC's `diagnostic_show_locus` rendering. Its RAII helpers create temporary source files, install a temporary `line_table` and line-map setup, provide a `file_cache`, and include a specialized UTF-8 one-line fixture with known display-column and byte-column relationships for multibyte caret/range tests. It is support infrastructure for locus-formatting tests rather than the diagnostic renderer itself.
